conviction_note: The print turns on the cash and runway line, not revenue. The Nov 18 royalty sale ($5.6M, and dropping a $4M minimum-cash covenant) did not update the 'into 1H 2027' runway, so the Q3 release is the likely place for an extension: a mild positive. Against it, a three-week, news-free slide from $2.04 to $0.99 on tiny volume, with Armistice registered to resell. The PDAC interim is a two-sided tail. Findings sum to +1.2; the scaled number is (2*0.52-1)*9 = +0.36. That is smaller because the slide shows a seller the print may not stop, and because the bar is a single sponsored estimate.
bar: Revenue $0.4M for Q3 2026 and EPS -$0.00 from a single sponsored estimate (Zacks SCR, 2026-09-01, https://s27.q4cdn.com/906368049/files/News/2026/Zacks_SCR_Research_09012026_BLRX_Vandermosten.pdf). No second estimate source was found. The company guide is cash runway 'into the first half of 2027' (Q2 release 2026-08-31, https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/biolinerx-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-corporate-update-302864836.html). Revenue is royalty only: Q2 was $294K on $1.6M of APHEXDA sales, and Q2 2025 was $304K. That makes $0.4M look high, but the stock does not trade on this line. The bar has one source, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: No usable option chain (baseline: empty_chain), so there is no skew. Short interest about 145.6K ADS, about 2.9% of float, 8.9-11.1 days to cover, from late-October trackers (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=BLRX, https://equibles.com/stocks/blrx/short-interest). The trend is flat to falling, and a June borrow fee of 39.3% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/blrx/). Not a crowded short. Liquidity is extreme: 20-day average volume 26.6K ADS, about $26K a day at $0.99. Armistice Capital holds the August 2026 offering ADSs and 2.02M warrants struck at $2.78, and an F-1 resale registration was filed 2026-09-25 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001498403/000117891326004612/zk2636130.htm). The stock is at its 52-week low, -51.5% over 20 days and -23.9% over 5. Market cap is about $7M on roughly 7.0M ADS (derived from the F-1 ownership table at 600 ordinary shares per ADS).

findings.finding: The Q3 release is the first scheduled update of the cash runway since the Nov 18 royalty sale. BioLineRx sells its 14.4% APHEXDA royalty to Soleus for $5.6M, about 6x the roughly $0.9M a year that royalty yields at Q2's $1.6M a quarter of sales. Part of the money goes to a partial repayment of the BlackRock loan, which removes a $4M minimum-cash covenant. The Nov 18 release stated no new runway. The standing guide is 'into 1H 2027', set on $13.1M of cash at June 30. My estimate is about $11-12M at Sept 30 (13.1 + 3.3 net August raise - ~$3.5M quarterly burn - ~$1.1M loan amortisation), against a market cap of about $7M. A runway extended to 2H 2027 or beyond, plus net cash near the market cap, is the likely new content.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior prints, closes from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BLRX?range=1y&interval=1d): Q3'25 on 2025-11-24 +7.7%; FY25 on 2026-03-23 -12.5%; Q1'26 on 2026-05-27 +6.6% (first GLIX1 patient); Q2'26 on 2026-08-31 +7.7%, the day after an offering-led drop. Runway was 'maintained' at each print, never extended. The royalty-sale day itself (2026-11-18) closed +2.7% on 295K volume, then gave it back (-8% over 2 sessions).
findings.why_not_priced: The deal release gave no cash balance and no runway. The stock fell from $1.15 to $0.99 after it, so the market has not bid it up on the extension. A market that had priced a longer runway would not hold the ADS near net cash. The counterweight is that the slide is a seller (finding 2), not a reading of the balance sheet.
findings.independence: Q2 release (cash $13.1M, runway into 1H27, $6.7M loan): https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/biolinerx-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-corporate-update-302864836.html. Zacks 1H26 burn $5.5M: https://s27.q4cdn.com/906368049/files/News/2026/Zacks_SCR_Research_09012026_BLRX_Vandermosten.pdf. The extension itself is my inference and is not company-stated.

findings.finding: A steady, news-free decline into the print: closes went from $2.04 (Oct 23) to $0.99 (Nov 20), down on almost every session, with volume rising from 2-5K to 10-33K ADS a day. The only company news in the period was positive or neutral (SNO posters with no significant adverse events, 4th GLIX1 cohort dosing, the royalty sale). The likely seller is the August offering investor. Armistice holds ADSs from the $2.78 offering and had an F-1 resale registration filed 2026-09-25, and $2.78 warrants that are deep out of the money. Tax-loss selling in a name -74% from its high fits too. If that seller is not finished, it sells into whatever the print says.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August raise drew -5.8% on announcement (2.76 to 2.60) and a 20% drop reported in late August coverage. The royalty-sale day saw a +2.7% close quickly sold back down.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself. The question is only whether the selling continues through Monday. A finished seller would show as volume drying up with the price stabilising; instead Nov 19 traded 32K ADS at -7.8%. Nov 20 was lighter (7.5K, intraday).
findings.independence: Armistice's holding and resale registration: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001498403/000117891326004612/zk2636130.htm. Offering terms: https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/biolinerx-announces-3-75-million-registered-direct-offering-and-concurrent-private-placement-302862746.html. No document shows Armistice actually selling, so the cause is an inference.

findings.finding: The motixafortide PDAC trial (CheMo4METPANC, NCT04543071) changed to 'Active, not recruiting' in its 2026-09-16 registry update, against the 'enrolling' wording in the company's Q2 release. The company has guided the prespecified interim/futility analysis (at 40% of PFS events) to happen 'in 2026'. So the Q3 release has to either report on it, reaffirm the 2026 timing or slip it to 2027. The market cap of about $7M is near net cash and puts almost no value on PDAC (Zacks models a 20% probability). A disclosed pass would be a large positive; a slip or futility would be a small negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No PDAC readout since the ASCO 2025 pilot data (4 of 11 progression-free for more than a year); its reaction is not in my sources. The 2026 guide was reaffirmed in March and August without a measurable move attributable to it.
findings.why_not_priced: The registry status change was not in any company release or in the coverage found. A market expecting a near-term interim on a $7M company would show some option value; the stock instead trades at about net cash. The status may only mean an enrolment pause or completion, not that a readout is imminent, so the size is small and centred near zero.
findings.independence: Company guide 'interim/futility analysis ... anticipate will occur in 2026' in the Q2 release: https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/biolinerx-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides-corporate-update-302864836.html. The same guide appears in the FY25 release: https://biolinerx.gcs-web.com/node/14251.

findings.finding: Royalty revenue, the only reported revenue line, looks set to miss the single sponsored estimate: Zacks has Q3 revenue at $0.4M, while Q2 was $294K on $1.6M of APHEXDA sales (down from $1.7M a year earlier). Ayrmid, a private company, has published no sales figures since. The line is now largely sold to Soleus, so it carries little weight.

outside_window.finding: The ADS closed below $1.00 on 2026-11-20 (intraday $0.99). A Nasdaq minimum-bid deficiency notice needs 30 consecutive business days below $1, so the earliest is about January 2027. The company has handled this before with ADS ratio changes (to 1:600 on 2025-01-30, per the F-1).
The Soleus royalty sale closes on or about 2026-11-30 and needs Ayrmid's consent to direct remittance. Until it closes, the $5.6M is not cash.

GLIX1 Phase 1/2a: 4th of 5 cohorts dosing, no significant treatment-emergent adverse events, full dose-escalation results guided to 1H 2027. The registry was updated 2026-11-04 with 4 sites and primary completion June 2027.
